body:
1. New pets' favourite toys (the Play button needs one): monkey frisbee, seal ball, bear squeaky toy, snake toy mouse. Today's pets keep theirs.
2. A big-needs pet's home counts as its toy at home (tree, pond, den, tank).
3. Moods follow today's hearts (happiness ÷ 20): 5 hearts very very happy, 3-4 happy, 2 normal, 0-1 sad.
4. Sick after about 1 more hour of play at 0-1 hearts.
5. Babies can enter the Pet Show. Growing up keeps counting while a pet is sick.
